semiconductor_relevance: High — Gradiant provides advanced water treatment solutions that are critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes, particularly in water reuse and wastewater management.
summary: Gradiant specializes in innovative water treatment solutions that enhance water recycling and reduce freshwater consumption in semiconductor fabs. Their patented technologies support sustainable production by improving water quality and minimizing wastewater discharge.
